summary.text: Michael Tinsley is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 76, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican incumbent Ross Ford.
An accountant who owns a small tax accounting firm, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are public education, affordable health care and responsible budgeting and taxation.

paragraphs.text: Michael Tinsley graduated from Broken Arrow High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University in 2014.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Broken Arrow, where he and his wife are raising two children, and that he owns a small tax accounting firm.

In the survey, Tinsley said education is his most important issue, citing his two young children and his wife's work as a teacher, and that he believes access to affordable health care should be a fundamental right.
He said that as a tax accountant he would work toward a more progressive tax system that benefits lower- and middle-income residents and would review how the state spends tax revenue.
